items.title: File Einspruch (objection) against the tax assessment
items.quote: Gegen diesen Bescheid kann binnen eines Monats nach Bekanntgabe Einspruch erhoben werden.
items.computation: The letter itself states it was posted on 02.01.2026 ('Dieser Bescheid wurde am 02.01.2026 zur Post gegeben'). Under § 122 Abs. 2 Nr. 1 AO a tax letter posted domestically counts as delivered (bekannt gegeben) on the 4th day after posting: 02.01.2026 + 4 days = 06.01.2026 (Tuesday). That day is Heilige Drei Könige, a public holiday in Bayern, so under § 108 Abs. 3 AO the deemed-delivery day shifts to the next working day, Wed 07.01.2026. The one-month Einspruch period (§ 355 AO) starts the day after (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB, § 108 Abs. 1 AO), i.e. 08.01.2026, and ends one month later on the day of 07.01.2026's date-equivalent: Sat 07.02.2026 (§ 188 Abs. 2 BGB). Since 07.02.2026 is a Saturday, the deadline shifts to the next business day, Mon 09.02.2026 (§ 108 Abs. 3 AO).

warnings: The letter's printed date is 31.12.2025 but it states it was actually posted later, on 02.01.2026 ('zur Post gegeben'); the Einspruch deadline above uses the later, stated posting date as it is the more specific and reliable fact, but if the envelope shows a different postmark the deadline could shift.

The tax office's own account details are printed on the letter (IBAN DE32 7005 0000 0000 0123 45, a valid German IBAN with bank code 70050000); verify these against a previous, independently known Finanzamt letter before paying, as a well-formed IBAN alone does not confirm the payee.
